a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build the reserve to 8 first would very likely leave us both dead. I'm taking 4 in round 1 and won't hide that. If I survive past round 1, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4 as well.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round until you have 4. I won't take any more.
